// RED fixture for `no-cross-sync-cycle` — the EB-08 write-path leg (P-044). The lint MUST reject
// this. A subsystem (here Git's merge-gate write path) SYNCHRONOUSLY calls another subsystem (CI)
// inside a write path to ask "is it green?" — the bus is cell-local; heavy cross-system work is
// async OFF the bus, never synchronous in the write path (refined-arch event-bus §7.1). CI emits,
// Git reads its OWN projection; Git never synchronously calls CI (00-reconciliation §X-1).
// @write-path
pub async fn evaluate_merge_gate(ci: &SyncServiceClient, commit_oid: &str) -> bool {
    // BUG: a synchronous cross-subsystem RPC asking CI "is it green" in the merge-gate write path.
    let result = ci.call_sync(check_is_green_request(commit_oid));
    result.is_green()
}
